source.query:
Unionizer("Requests", "HttpIncomingRequests")
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(1d)
| where TaskName == "HttpIncomingRequestEndWithSuccess"
| where tolower(targetResourceProvider) == "microsoft.compute"
| summarize subcount = dcount(subscriptionId) by Operation = operationName, HttpMethod = httpMethod
| extend TargetResourceProvider = "MICROSOFT.COMPUTE"
| project TargetResourceProvider, Operation, HttpMethod, subcount
